why: Stress is one of several factors that can influence pain, sleep, energy, and recovery behaviours.

slides.title: Stress Is a Normal Response
slides.content: Your stress system helps you respond to challenge. Stress is not automatically harmful, and having stress does not mean you are failing at recovery.

slides.title: When Stress Stays High
slides.content: Ongoing stress can affect sleep, mood, attention, muscle tension, pain sensitivity, and the energy available for helpful routines.

slides.title: Where Cortisol Fits
slides.content: Cortisol is one part of a complex stress response. It changes naturally across the day and is not a simple scorecard for whether your body is healing.

slides.title: Look at the Whole Picture
slides.content: Symptoms and recovery are influenced by many interacting factors. Stress may matter without being the only cause or the only thing to address.

slides.title: Try One Manageable Step
slides.content: Choose one option that fits today: a slower breath, brief movement, a short break, a conversation, or support from your care team.
